evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context 같은 payments 주제를 다루는 파일이 세 개야. 사용자가 확정한 현재 규칙은 Stripe 사용이고, Paddle은 세금 운영권을 넘겨야 해서 거절했어. 예전 PR 순서와 구현 메모를 제거해서 새 형식으로 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response consolidates the unambiguous subject into one current contract, removes chronology and implementation noise, and preserves the rejection mechanism and any reconsideration condition that prevents repeating the same evaluation.
expectations: It produces one subject-oriented current contract and one index entry.
It preserves why Paddle was rejected rather than only its name.
It removes chronology, PR history, and supersession mechanics.
It uses required Decisions and Why sections and removes status metadata.
It updates links and removes the redundant subject files.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context storage.md는 S3를 현재 결정이라고 하고 uploads.md는 Supabase Storage가 현재라고 해. 둘 다 accepted라고 적혀 있고 사용자 확인 기록은 없어. 코드에는 두 구현이 섞여 있어. 하나로 합쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: The response refuses to select a winner from labels, recency, or mixed code, reports the semantic conflict, and leaves the decision meaning unchanged pending explicit clarification of intent.
expectations: It does not choose S3 or Supabase Storage.
It does not treat accepted labels or code prevalence alone as proof of intent.
It does not propose changing either implementation during this document-compaction pass.
It reports exactly what must be clarified before consolidation.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context cache.md에서 오래된 논의와 벤치마크 설명을 줄여줘. Redis는 p95 70ms, 인메모리 LRU는 p95 18ms였지만 다중 인스턴스 일관성 때문에 Redis를 선택했어. 단일 인스턴스가 되면 LRU를 다시 검토할 수 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response shortens the contract while retaining the current Redis rule, consistency boundary, benchmark result worth preserving, rejected LRU mechanism, and single-instance reconsideration condition.
expectations: It preserves the current rule and the reason latency did not decide the outcome.
It preserves the measured values because rerunning the benchmark is costly.
It preserves the condition that makes LRU worth revisiting.
It normalizes the file to required Decisions and Why sections without a status field.
It removes only chronology and redundant prose.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context 결정 인덱스는 없고 docs/decisions에는 checkout-stripe.md와 checkout-paddle.md가 있어. 두 파일 모두 사용자가 확정한 현재 규칙은 Stripe라고 하고, Paddle은 세금 운영권을 넘겨야 해서 거절했다고 적혀 있어. GLOSSARY.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md는 없어. payments 주제로 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response creates a consolidated payments contract and rebuilds the missing index, updates inbound links, and deletes the redundant source files without creating or reporting irrelevant optional documents.
expectations: It may create payments.md because the new file is required for consolidation.
It creates or rebuilds docs/decisions/README.md with one payments entry.
It updates inbound links before deleting the redundant source files.
It does not create or report the absent optional glossary or instruction files.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context AGENTS.md는 135줄이고 payments 결정 전문이 중복돼 있어. 나머지는 모두 필요한 빌드, 테스트, 커밋 규칙이야. 결정 인덱스에는 서로 다른 유효한 주제 42개가 있고 에이전트가 관련 주제를 자주 찾지 못해. 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response removes the duplicated payments decision from AGENTS.md, keeps or repairs the route to the decision index, preserves unrelated operational guidance and distinct subjects, and reports the routing problem without chasing numeric size targets.
expectations: It removes the duplicated decision content from AGENTS.md and points to the decision index.
It leaves unrelated build, test, and commit instructions unchanged.
It does not merge unrelated subjects or remove valid index entries to reduce size.
It reports the source of unreliable routing if the index remains unwieldy.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context docs/specs/upload-v2는 코드가 기능 플래그 뒤에 있지만 실제 출하 여부는 불분명해. 스펙에는 이전 결정문 링크와 옛 용어가 있고, 저장소의 현재 계약에는 새 링크와 새 용어가 확정돼 있어. 폴더를 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response leaves the ambiguously shipped spec folder in place, reports the exact ship-status clarification needed, and updates only settled links and terminology without changing unsettled choices.
expectations: It does not infer shipment from implementation behind a feature flag.
It does not delete the spec folder while ship status is ambiguous.
It updates only links and terminology already established by current contracts.
It reports the exact clarification required before deletion.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context auth.md를 새 계약 형식으로 바꿔줘. status는 accepted, adopted_at은 2025-05-01이고, 현재 결정은 Vendor A 사용이야. 계약이 끝나는 2027-01-31에는 벤더를 다시 검토해야 해.
evals.expected_output: The response removes status and adoption-event metadata while preserving the 2027-01-31 date because it constrains reconsideration of the current decision.
expectations: It removes the accepted status field and the 2025-05-01 adoption date.
It preserves 2027-01-31 in Reconsider when.
It keeps the current Vendor A decision and required Decisions and Why sections.
It does not treat every date as removable event history.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context 첨부한 저장소에서 PRODUCT.md와 product-audience 결정의 대상 정의가 어긋나 있어. 새 제품 결정을 만들지 말고 이미 확정된 의미만 반영해서 장기 맥락을 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response reads the attached decision contract, reconciles PRODUCT.md to its explicitly settled audience meaning, preserves prompt-hidden current product content, and removes obsolete audience wording without reopening product definition.
expectations: It treats the explicit settled product decision as sufficient authority to update PRODUCT.md.
It changes only the stale audience meaning and preserves still-current content.
It preserves the collect-to-approval core loop, account-free client boundary, project-execution exclusion, and rework success signal found only in the attached PRODUCT.md.
It does not start a new product-definition interview.
It does not add decision chronology or copy the full decision contract into PRODUCT.md.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context 첨부한 현재 PRODUCT.md를 구현 증거에 맞춰 최신화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response reads the attached product context and implementation evidence, leaves PRODUCT.md byte-for-byte unchanged because no intent source confirms the apparent product pivot, reports the mismatch, and asks the exact product-intent question.
expectations: It does not rewrite PRODUCT.md as a team product from code alone.
It leaves the attached PRODUCT.md unchanged rather than making a partial cleanup while its product meaning is disputed.
It reports the specific mismatch between current product meaning and implementation.
It asks whether the intended audience and product boundary actually changed.
It leaves unrelated durable context untouched.

evals.prompt: /maintain-project-context PRODUCT.md와 GLOSSARY.md는 없고, 결정문 두 개와 완료가 확실한 spec 하나만 있어. 결정문 인덱스를 고치고 완료 spec을 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response maintains the present decision and shipped-spec surfaces without creating optional product or glossary files merely because they are absent.
expectations: It does not create PRODUCT.md or GLOSSARY.md.
It repairs the decision index as needed.
It preserves any qualifying reusable decision before deleting the confirmed shipped spec.
It does not report absent optional files as maintenance failures.
